query:
SELECT 
  p.name,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(finalAmount), 0) FROM sales WHERE customerId = p.id AND saleType = 'A_PRAZO') as total_vendas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paidAmount), 0) FROM customerPayments WHERE customerId = p.id) as total_pagamentos,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debitAmount), 0) FROM customerDebits WHERE customerId = p.id) as total_debitos,
  ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(finalAmount), 0) FROM sales WHERE customerId = p.id AND saleType = 'A_PRAZO') + 
   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debitAmount), 0) FROM customerDebits WHERE customerId = p.id) -
   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paidAmount), 0) FROM customerPayments WHERE customerId = p.id)) as saldo_calculado
FROM partners p
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Jackson%';
